article.story: EASTON, Pa. -- — Cooper Kesler’s 25 points helped Lafayette defeat King’s 104-67 on Thursday. Kesler also added six assists for the Leopards (1-1). Beckett Currie scored 15 points while shooting 6 for 13, including 3 for 9 from beyond the arc. Jasraj Gill finished 6 of 8 from the field to finish with 14 points. Matt Christian led the Monarchs in scoring, finishing with 15 points. Ben Rodner-Tims added 11 points and eight rebounds for King’s. Sean Forrest also had 11 points and three steals. Lafayette led 55-31 at halftime, with Kesler racking up 13 points. Lafayette extended its lead to 79-41 during the second half, fueled by a 12-0 run. Kesler scored a team-high 12 points in the second half. Up next Lafayette visits Saint Joseph’s in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
